setting: school bus breaks down on the way to a trip

line: Bus achanak ruk gayi hai, aur lagta hai ki engine mein koi gambhir samasya hai.

setting: school bus breaks down on the way to a trip
speaker: SAMAR
line: Mujhe bhi chinta ho rahi hai, kyunki hamari yatra ka samay pehle hi tay tha.

setting: school bus breaks down on the way to a trip
speaker: KARAN
line: Driver saheb ne kaha hai ki woh mechanic ko phone kar chuke hain, lekin unhe abhi tak koi uttar nahi mila.

setting: school bus breaks down on the way to a trip
speaker: SAMAR
line: Is sthiti mein hume dhairya rakhna chahiye, kyunki ghabraane se koi bhi samadhan nahi nikalta.

setting: school bus breaks down on the way to a trip
speaker: KARAN
line: Mujhe lagta hai ki hume teachers ko bhi turant soochit karna avashyak hai, taaki woh aage ka nirnay le sakein.

setting: school bus breaks down on the way to a trip
speaker: SAMAR
line: Haan Karan, tum sahi kah rahe ho, aur hamari team ko ek saath milkar yeh kaam karna chahiye.

setting: school bus breaks down on the way to a trip
speaker: KARAN
line: Is baat par mujhe sandeh hai ki bus ko jaldi theek kiya ja sakega, kyunki parts ki vyavastha bhi kathin hai.

setting: school bus breaks down on the way to a trip
speaker: SAMAR
line: Samar ne kaha ki woh chhoti si madad bhi kar sakta hai, aur bus ke aas paas ki jagah ko surakshit karna sambhav hai.

setting: school bus breaks down on the way to a trip
speaker: KARAN
line: Chinta mat karo Samar, hum apna plan dhire dhire aage badha sakte hain aur sabhi ka dhyan rakh sakte hain.

setting: school bus breaks down on the way to a trip
speaker: SAMAR
line: Mujhe vishwas hai ki hum is sankat se bahar nikal jayenge, aur agli baar hum zyada taiyari ke saath yatra par aayenge.

speaker: DIVYA
line: Mujhe lagta hai ki hum sab ko aaj subah se pehle hi relief camp pahunch jana chahiye tha.

speaker: TEJAS
line: Haan, lekin transport ka intezaam hi nahin tha, isliye hum der se pahunche.

speaker: PAYAL
line: Humne socha tha ki aaj hum pandrah parivaaron tak raashan pahunchayenge, lekin abhi tak sirf chaar parivaar hi mil paaye hain.

speaker: DIVYA
line: Chinta mat karo, Payal. Hum agle ek ghante mein baaki kaam bhi milkar nipta sakte hain.

speaker: TEJAS
line: Mujhe is sthiti se nirasha ho rahi hai, kyunki log bahut pareshan hain aur koi bhi hamari baat nahin sun raha.

speaker: PAYAL
line: Ek samasya yeh bhi hai ki volunteers ke paas sahi suchna nahin hai, isliye ek hi kaam do baar ho raha hai.

speaker: DIVYA
line: Mera maksad sirf itna hai ki is kaam ko vyavasthit tareeke se poora kar sakoon, aur hum sab mil kar kuch achha kar sakein.

speaker: TEJAS
line: Theek hai, lekin pehle hume ek spasht plan banana hoga, varna hum aise hi ghoomte rahenge aur kuch bhi nahin hoga.

speaker: PAYAL
line: Pichhli baar bhi humne yahi galti ki thi, aur tab hi humne apni mehnat ka sahi phal nahin paaya tha.

speaker: DIVYA
line: Humein is anubhav se seekhna chahiye, aur agli baar zyada taiyari ke saath aana chahiye, taaki sabhi ko sahayata mil sake.

speaker: SAKSHI
line: Yash, visarjan ki taiyari ka kaam aaj poora karna avashyak hai, kyunki kal subah jaldi shuru hogi.

speaker: YASH
line: Mujhe lagta hai ki hum samay par nahi pahunch paayenge, kyunki pandal ki sajawat abhi bhi adhoori hai.

speaker: MANAV
line: Mera maksad sirf itna hai ki hum sab milkar kaam baant lein, taaki kisi par bahut bojh na pade.

line: Pichle saal bhi hamari team ne jaldi mein galat nirnay liye, aur uska parinaam hum sabko bhugatna pada.

speaker: YASH
line: Haan, Sakshi, aur is baar bhi wahi samasya dikhai de rahi hai, jisse mujhe bahut chinta ho rahi hai.

speaker: MANAV
line: Yeh sthiti dekhkar nirasha hoti hai, lekin hume apni galtiyon se seekhkar aage badhna chahiye.

speaker: SAKSHI
line: Maine aaj subah dhol-tasha walon se baat ki thi, woh shaam tak aane ke liye taiyar hain.

speaker: YASH
line: Yeh achhi khabar hai, Manav, aur isse mujhe kuch himmat mili hai ki hum visarjan theek se kar paayenge.

speaker: MANAV
line: Main tumhari mehnat ki prashansa karta hoon, Sakshi, kyunki tumne sabse pehle jagah ka intezaam sambhaala tha.

line: Hum sab milkar apna lakshya paa sakte hain, lekin shart yeh hai ki har vyakti apni zimmedari poori kare aur samay ka dhyaan rakhe.

speaker: PRANAV

speaker: SAMAR
line: Yeh bahut accha vichar hai, Pranav. Main tumhari soch ki prashansa karta hoon, aur mujhe vishwas hai ki isse kaam aasaan hoga.

speaker: YASH
line: Lekin mandap ki booking abhi tak pakki nahi hui hai, jiski wajah se mujhe thodi chinta ho rahi hai.

speaker: PRANAV
line: Humne kal hi vyavastha karne ka nirnay liya tha, par vendor ne samay par jawab nahi diya.

speaker: YASH
line: Dhairya rakhna avashyak hai, kyunki ghar ke sabhi log apne apne kaam mein vyast hain aur sahayata ki zaroorat hai.

speaker: PRANAV
line: Sabhi mehmanon ki suchi taiyar ho chuki hai, aur kal tak nimantran patr bhi baant diye jayenge.

speaker: SAMAR
line: Yeh sunkar achha laga, par bhojan ki vyavastha ke baare mein humne abhi tak koi uttam nirnay nahi liya hai.

line: Mujhe lagta hai ki kal subah sabhi log milkar ek baithak karein, jisme har vyakti apna kaam aur lakshya batayega.
